<!--axz-cofre--><!DOCTYPE html><html lang="es"><head><meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta http-equiv="Cache-Control" content="no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"><meta http-equiv="Pragma" content="no-cache"><meta http-equiv="Expires" content="0"><meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"><title>AXIZ · ACCESO PRIVADO</title>
<style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 50% at 50% 0%,#12120c,#06060a 70%);
color:#f4f4f8;font-family:Georgia,serif;min-height:100vh}
#puerta{text-align:center}
#clavebox{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:7vh;z-index:80;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;
padding:0 22px;text-align:center;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .8s ease}
#clavebox.visible{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
body.portada #clavebox:not(.visible){display:none}
body.interior #bootIntro,body.interior #boot{display:none!important}
body.interior #axz-lang-switch{display:none}
#axz-lang-switch{position:fixed;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:90}
#axz-lang-switch select{background:#0d0c09;border:1px solid #3a3426;border-radius:7px;color:#c2c2d4;
font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;padding:6px 8px;outline:none;cursor:pointer}
#axz-lang-switch select:focus{border-color:#e0b13a}

#puerta h1{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:5px;color:#e0b13a}
#puerta .s{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#8e8ea6;margin-top:10px}
#puerta form{margin-top:30px;display:flex;gap:9px}
#puerta input{flex:1;background:#0d0c09;border:1px solid #3a3426;border-radius:9px;color:#f4f4f8;
font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:3px;padding:13px 16px;outline:none;text-align:center}
#puerta input:focus{border-color:#e0b13a}
#puerta button{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;background:#e0b13a;
color:#0a0805;border:none;border-radius:9px;padding:0 20px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
#aviso{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#e06050;margin-top:14px;min-height:14px}
#puerta .pie{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#5a5648;margin-top:34px;line-height:1.8}
#cargando{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:500;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 50% at 50% 40%,#12120c,#06060a 75%)}
#cargando{opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s ease}
#cargando.visible{opacity:1}
#cargando .sello{display:none}
#cargando .ct{margin-top:26px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:3.5px;color:#c9a84a}
#cargando .cb{width:150px;height:2px;background:rgba(224,177,58,.14);margin-top:14px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:2px}
#cargando .cb i{display:block;height:100%;width:40%;background:#e0b13a;border-radius:2px;animation:cbCorre 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes cbCorre{0%{transform:translateX(-110%)}100%{transform:translateX(360%)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#cargando .giro,#cargando .cb i{animation:none}}
</style></head><body class="interior">
<div id="axz-lang-switch"><select id="axz-lang-select" aria-label="idioma">
<option value="es">ES</option><option value="en">EN</option><option value="fr">FR</option>
<option value="de">DE</option><option value="pt">PT</option><option value="it">IT</option>
<option value="zh">ZH</option><option value="ar">AR</option></select></div>
<div id="puerta">
<div id="clavebox"><h1>AXIZ</h1><div class="s">INTELLIGENCE HOLDINGS · <span id="axz-p-acceso">ACCESO PRIVADO</span></div>
<form id="f"><input id="clave" type="password" placeholder="&#9679;&#9679;&#9679;&#9679;&#9679;&#9679;" autocomplete="current-password"><button id="axz-p-entrar">ENTRAR</button></form>
<div id="aviso"></div>
<div class="pie"><span id="axz-p-material">MATERIAL CIFRADO (AES-256) · SE ABRE SOLO EN SU NAVEGADOR</span><br>
<span id="axz-p-analisis">AN&Aacute;LISIS, NO ASESORAMIENTO</span> · 2026-09-23</div></div></div>
<div id="cargando"><img class="sello" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="escudo AXIZ">
<div class="ct">ABRIENDO LA CASA&hellip;</div><div class="cb"><i></i></div></div>
<script>
var SAL='IIll6ChCG3c6SKiOCk2ZFA==',NONCE='OJkiOk2PqkE5nH1z',COFRE='',VUELTAS=200000;
function b64a(s){var b=atob(s),a=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++)a[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);return a;}
function intenta(clave,silencio){
if(!window.crypto||!window.crypto.subtle){cargando(false);document.getElementById('puerta').style.visibility='';
document.getElementById('aviso').textContent=axzPT('httpsAviso');
return Promise.resolve();}
var enc=new TextEncoder();
return crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',enc.encode(clave),'PBKDF2',false,['deriveKey'])
.then(function(k){return crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:'PBKDF2',salt:b64a(SAL),iterations:VUELTAS,hash:'SHA-256'},k,{name:'AES-GCM',length:256},false,['decrypt']);})
.then(function(llave){return crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:b64a(NONCE)},llave,b64a(COFRE));})
.then(function(plano){try{sessionStorage.setItem('axz_clave',clave);}catch(e){}
var h=new TextDecoder().decode(plano);var e=Math.max(0,1900-(window.axzT0?Date.now()-window.axzT0:0));setTimeout(function(){document.open();document.write(h);document.close();},e);})
.catch(function(){try{sessionStorage.removeItem('axz_clave');}catch(e){}
cargando(false);document.getElementById('puerta').style.visibility='';
if(!silencio){document.getElementById('aviso').textContent=axzPT('claveIncorrecta');var ge=document.getElementById('axzGateErr');if(ge)ge.textContent=axzPT('claveIncorrecta');}});}
var AXZ_P_I18N={
es:{acceso:'ACCESO PRIVADO',entrar:'ENTRAR',claveIncorrecta:'CLAVE INCORRECTA',httpsAviso:'ESTA PAGINA NECESITA ABRIRSE POR HTTPS -- revisa que el enlace empiece por https://',material:'MATERIAL CIFRADO (AES-256) · SE ABRE SOLO EN SU NAVEGADOR',analisis:'ANÁLISIS, NO ASESORAMIENTO'},
en:{acceso:'PRIVATE ACCESS',entrar:'ENTER',claveIncorrecta:'INCORRECT PASSWORD',httpsAviso:'THIS PAGE NEEDS TO BE OPENED OVER HTTPS -- check that the link starts with https://',material:'ENCRYPTED MATERIAL (AES-256) · OPENS ONLY IN YOUR BROWSER',analisis:'ANALYSIS, NOT ADVICE'},
fr:{acceso:'ACCÈS PRIVÉ',entrar:'ENTRER',claveIncorrecta:'MOT DE PASSE INCORRECT',httpsAviso:'CETTE PAGE DOIT ÊTRE OUVERTE VIA HTTPS -- vérifiez que le lien commence par https://',material:'MATÉRIEL CHIFFRÉ (AES-256) · OUVERTURE UNIQUEMENT DANS VOTRE NAVIGATEUR',analisis:'ANALYSE, PAS DE CONSEIL'},
de:{acceso:'PRIVATER ZUGANG',entrar:'EINTRETEN',claveIncorrecta:'FALSCHES PASSWORT',httpsAviso:'DIESE SEITE MUSS ÜBER HTTPS GEÖFFNET WERDEN -- prüfen Sie, ob der Link mit https:// beginnt',material:'VERSCHLÜSSELTES MATERIAL (AES-256) · ÖFFNET NUR IM BROWSER',analisis:'ANALYSE, KEINE BERATUNG'},
pt:{acceso:'ACESSO PRIVADO',entrar:'ENTRAR',claveIncorrecta:'SENHA INCORRETA',httpsAviso:'ESTA PAGINA PRECISA SER ABERTA POR HTTPS -- verifique se o link comeca por https://',material:'MATERIAL CIFRADO (AES-256) · ABRE SOMENTE NO SEU NAVEGADOR',analisis:'ANÁLISE, NÃO ACONSELHAMENTO'},
it:{acceso:'ACCESSO PRIVATO',entrar:'ENTRA',claveIncorrecta:'PASSWORD ERRATA',httpsAviso:'QUESTA PAGINA DEVE ESSERE APERTA VIA HTTPS -- verifica che il link inizi con https://',material:'MATERIALE CIFRATO (AES-256) · SI APRE SOLO NEL BROWSER',analisis:'ANALISI, NON CONSULENZA'},
zh:{acceso:'私人访问',entrar:'进入',claveIncorrecta:'密码错误',httpsAviso:'此页面需要通过HTTPS打开 -- 请检查链接是否以https://开头',material:'加密材料 (AES-256) · 仅在您的浏览器中打开',analisis:'分析，非建议'},
ar:{acceso:'دخول خاص',entrar:'دخول',claveIncorrecta:'كلمة مرور خاطئة',httpsAviso:'يجب فتح هذه الصفحة عبر HTTPS -- تحقق من أن الرابط يبدأ بـ https://',material:'مواد مشفرة (AES-256) · تُفتح فقط في متصفحك',analisis:'تحليل، وليس نصيحة'}
};
function axzPT(k){var l=(window.AXZ_P_LANG||'es');var d=AXZ_P_I18N[l]||AXZ_P_I18N.es;return d[k]||AXZ_P_I18N.es[k]||'';}
function axzPuertaRepintar(){
var a=document.getElementById('axz-p-acceso');if(a)a.textContent=axzPT('acceso');
var e=document.getElementById('axz-p-entrar');if(e)e.textContent=axzPT('entrar');
var m=document.getElementById('axz-p-material');if(m)m.textContent=axzPT('material');
var an=document.getElementById('axz-p-analisis');if(an)an.textContent=axzPT('analisis');
document.documentElement.setAttribute('dir',(window.AXZ_P_LANG==='ar')?'rtl':'ltr');
}
function axzPuertaIdioma(l){window.AXZ_P_LANG=l;try{localStorage.setItem('axz_lang',l);}catch(e){}axzPuertaRepintar();}
(function(){var sel=document.getElementById('axz-lang-select');var saved='es';
try{saved=localStorage.getItem('axz_lang')||'es';}catch(e){}
window.AXZ_P_LANG=saved;if(sel){sel.value=saved;sel.addEventListener('change',function(){axzPuertaIdioma(sel.value);});}
axzPuertaRepintar();})();

setTimeout(function(){var cb=document.getElementById('clavebox');if(cb)cb.classList.add('visible');},250);

function cargando(v){var c=document.getElementById('cargando');c.style.display=v?'flex':'none';if(v){window.axzT0=Date.now();requestAnimationFrame(function(){c.classList.add('visible');});}else{c.classList.remove('visible');}}
document.getElementById('f').addEventListener('submit',function(ev){ev.preventDefault();
var c=document.getElementById('clave').value;if(!c)return;
cargando(true);intenta(c,false);});
try{var g=sessionStorage.getItem('axz_clave');if(g){
document.getElementById('puerta').style.visibility='hidden';cargando(true);intenta(g,true);}}catch(e){}
</script></body></html>
